Download Cindy  ·  Website  ·  Build with us  ·  Get help

★ GitHub Trending #1 · 2026.10.26

Cindy is an **open-source AI agent, ready out of the box and yours to shape**. Connect your computers and phone, bring the models and subscriptions you already use, and build a companion that knows how you like to work. ## All your devices. One Cindy. Your work computer, home desktop, laptop and phone belong together. - **Pick up the same work.** Open a session from another device, continue the conversation, and access its files without copying everything into a new chat. - **Share more than a screen.** Use model providers configured on another computer — including supported subscriptions, API providers and local models. - **Reach your whole desktop.** Built-in remote desktop on your phone lets you open apps, type and operate a connected computer when a chat isn't enough. Your computer becomes your server: **no server rental or self-hosting setup**.
How connections and data work For remote access to your computers, keep them online, sign in with the same account and enable the relevant permissions. Model sharing requires allowing remote access to that provider; remote desktop also needs its own permissions. Project files stay on their computer — remote access is not whole-disk sync. Cloud companions sync their conversations, memory, skills and shared attachments through Cindy's services; model providers process the requests sent to them. Provider and service billing still apply.
## Keep your favorite agents. Get a better way to work. Already using Claude Code or Codex? Cindy brings them together with **Pi**, then adds a shared interface, multi-device access, tools and a companion of your own. | Harness | What it brings | | --- | --- | | **Claude Code** | Claude Code's agent workflow, with Cindy's interface and connected tools. | | **Codex** | Codex's coding workflow, available alongside your other agents. | | **Pi** | A lean, open-source, extensible agent with support for multiple model providers. | Choose a supported harness and model combination, and change it as the work evolves. Your session stays in Cindy; switching harnesses hands off or rebuilds the engine context rather than making their internal states identical. **One agent not enough? Let her lead a team.** Use different agents for planning, parallel implementation and independent review, with a shared goal and clear acceptance criteria. ## Real work, in your actual tools Work with your files, browser and apps. Ask for a change, inspect what happened, and keep working from the result. Answers can include **charts, interactive controls and rich HTML**, not just a wall of text. Build a recurring routine with **automations**, or hand over work through connected chat channels such as Slack and Telegram. Connect more tools through **Skills, plugins and MCP**. ## Ready from day one. Yours to shape over time. - **Create your own companions.** Give them a role, instructions, skills and recurring work — a reviewer, researcher, project partner, or something of your own. - **Make experience reusable.** Keep useful preferences and knowledge in memory; turn a good way of working into a Skill you can reuse and share. - **Extend the product.** Discover Skills and plugins in SkillHub, connect your own tools, or build on the [official plugins](https://github.com/makecindy/cindy-official-plugins). - **Help shape Cindy.** Audit the code, fork it, improve an interaction, fix a bug, or contribute a useful integration. The client is Apache-2.0 licensed. Open source means more than visible — it means changeable. [Build Cindy with us →](CONTRIBUTING.en.md) ## Start with what you already have The **client is free**. Authorize a supported subscription you already pay for, including Claude Code or Codex plans, connect your own API keys, or use a local model. You can also use Cindy's managed model service. Provider limits and billing still apply; the free client does not mean unlimited model usage. **macOS · Windows · Linux · iOS · Android** [Download Cindy](https://cindy.app/download) · [Service pricing](https://cindy.app/pricing) Linux users: see the [Ubuntu, Arch Linux and Omarchy installation guide](docs/linux.md) for installation, updates, keyring setup and migration from a manual install.

Okay, maybe a little popular.

Every star means something.

See [pricing](https://cindy.app/pricing). | | Skip Sign-In | No Cindy sign-in required | Choose “Skip Sign-In” on the login screen to use local agents; the app then shows the account state as “Not signed in”. Server-backed capabilities are unavailable in this state. | ### Prerequisites - **Node.js** 22.x - **pnpm** 10.x (v11 is not yet supported) - **Git LFS** ### Getting started Contributor setup, Git LFS, dependency updates, and access requirements are maintained in [`CONTRIBUTING.en.md`](CONTRIBUTING.en.md). Plugins are installed through SkillHub or manually. Use `cn` for Mainland China accounts and `global` for everyone else; do not rely on the internal default. Full desktop, mobile, data-isolation, and validation workflows are in [`CONTRIBUTING.en.md`](CONTRIBUTING.en.md). “Skip Sign-In” on the login screen runs local agents without a Cindy account (shown in the app as “Not signed in”), not a connection to a local server. Server-backed capabilities are unavailable in this state. **About the default servers:** the client connects to Cindy's official cloud services by default (endpoint manifests in [`config/endpoint.json`](config/endpoint.json) and [`config/endpoint.global.json`](config/endpoint.global.json); desktop auto-updates also come from the official CDN). English · 简体中文

Download Cindy  ·  Website  ·  Build with us  ·  Get help

★ GitHub Trending #1 · 2026.10.26

Cindy is an open-source AI agent, ready out of the box and yours to shape. Connect your computers and phone, bring the models and subscriptions you already use, and build a companion that knows how you like to work.

All your devices. One Cindy.

Your work computer, home desktop, laptop and phone belong together.

  • Pick up the same work. Open a session from another device, continue the conversation, and access its files without copying everything into a new chat.
  • Share more than a screen. Use model providers configured on another computer — including supported subscriptions, API providers and local models.
  • Reach your whole desktop. Built-in remote desktop on your phone lets you open apps, type and operate a connected computer when a chat isn't enough.

Your computer becomes your server: no server rental or self-hosting setup.

How connections and data work

For remote access to your computers, keep them online, sign in with the same account and enable the relevant permissions. Model sharing requires allowing remote access to that provider; remote desktop also needs its own permissions. Project files stay on their computer — remote access is not whole-disk sync. Cloud companions sync their conversations, memory, skills and shared attachments through Cindy's services; model providers process the requests sent to them. Provider and service billing still apply.

Keep your favorite agents. Get a better way to work.

Already using Claude Code or Codex? Cindy brings them together with Pi, then adds a shared interface, multi-device access, tools and a companion of your own.

Harness What it brings
Claude Code Claude Code's agent workflow, with Cindy's interface and connected tools.
Codex Codex's coding workflow, available alongside your other agents.
Pi A lean, open-source, extensible agent with support for multiple model providers.

Choose a supported harness and model combination, and change it as the work evolves. Your session stays in Cindy; switching harnesses hands off or rebuilds the engine context rather than making their internal states identical.

One agent not enough? Let her lead a team. Use different agents for planning, parallel implementation and independent review, with a shared goal and clear acceptance criteria.

Real work, in your actual tools

Work with your files, browser and apps. Ask for a change, inspect what happened, and keep working from the result. Answers can include charts, interactive controls and rich HTML, not just a wall of text.

Build a recurring routine with automations, or hand over work through connected chat channels such as Slack and Telegram. Connect more tools through Skills, plugins and MCP.

Ready from day one. Yours to shape over time.

  • Create your own companions. Give them a role, instructions, skills and recurring work — a reviewer, researcher, project partner, or something of your own.
  • Make experience reusable. Keep useful preferences and knowledge in memory; turn a good way of working into a Skill you can reuse and share.
  • Extend the product. Discover Skills and plugins in SkillHub, connect your own tools, or build on the official plugins.
  • Help shape Cindy. Audit the code, fork it, improve an interaction, fix a bug, or contribute a useful integration. The client is Apache-2.0 licensed.

Open source means more than visible — it means changeable. Build Cindy with us →

Start with what you already have

The client is free. Authorize a supported subscription you already pay for, including Claude Code or Codex plans, connect your own API keys, or use a local model. You can also use Cindy's managed model service. Provider limits and billing still apply; the free client does not mean unlimited model usage.

macOS · Windows · Linux · iOS · Android

Download Cindy · Service pricing

Linux users: see the Ubuntu, Arch Linux and Omarchy installation guide for installation, updates, keyring setup and migration from a manual install.

Okay, maybe a little popular.

Every star means something.

For developers

This repository contains Cindy's open-source desktop and mobile clients and their shared packages, organized as a pnpm monorepo.

What's in this repo

Path Description
apps/desktop Electron desktop client
apps/mobile Expo / React Native mobile client
packages/* Shared client capabilities (auth, device-link, agent orchestration, model providers, …)
apps/*-bin Tool binaries shipped with the desktop app; none are committed — claude-code, codex, and ripgrep are downloaded per platform by pnpm install, and the Android platform-tools binaries are fetched (pinned version, sha256-verified) before Windows packaging

Not in this repo: the backend service lives in a separate repository and is not part of this monorepo.

Mode Account requirement Availability
Hosted service Cindy cloud account Use Cindy's full hosted service. See pricing.
Skip Sign-In No Cindy sign-in required Choose “Skip Sign-In” on the login screen to use local agents; the app then shows the account state as “Not signed in”. Server-backed capabilities are unavailable in this state.

Prerequisites

  • Node.js 22.x
  • pnpm 10.x (v11 is not yet supported)
  • Git LFS

Getting started

Contributor setup, Git LFS, dependency updates, and access requirements are maintained in CONTRIBUTING.en.md. Plugins are installed through SkillHub or manually.

Minimal entry point:

git clone https://github.com/makecindy/cindy.git
cd cindy
git lfs pull
pnpm install

Development entry points

# Mainland China Cindy account
pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=cn

# Global Cindy account
pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=global

Remote development uses your own Cindy cloud account and existing login state, so you can continue existing sessions and work while developing the client. Use cn for Mainland China accounts and global for everyone else; do not rely on the internal default. Full desktop, mobile, data-isolation, and validation workflows are in CONTRIBUTING.en.md.

“Skip Sign-In” on the login screen runs local agents without a Cindy account (shown in the app as “Not signed in”), not a connection to a local server. Server-backed capabilities are unavailable in this state.

About the default servers: the client connects to Cindy's official cloud services by default (endpoint manifests in config/endpoint.json and config/endpoint.global.json; desktop auto-updates also come from the official CDN). This is intentional — external developers don't need to self-host a server: sign in with your own Cindy account in a dev build and develop / test directly against the official servers.

Skill Hub migration uses two separate manifest fields: released clients keep using skillhubApiBaseUrl (the deprecated XD proxy), while current clients use cindySkillHubApiBaseUrl. The current client deliberately does not fall back to the legacy field when the new endpoint is absent.

Architecture

  • DESIGN.md — visual design system, color tokens, and UI conventions
  • docs/README.md — complete documentation and rules index
  • docs/auth-realm-routing.md — organization SSO region discovery and session endpoint routing
  • CONTRIBUTING.en.md — contributor setup, validation, and submission workflow
  • AGENTS.md — engineering rules, launch/runtime contracts, and module boundaries
  • docs/dev-rules/ — deep-dive architecture docs (e.g. Orca multi-agent orchestration)

Contributing

Contributions go through pull requests into main. Read CONTRIBUTING.en.md first, then use .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md. Every commit needs a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off (git commit -s); a DCO check on each pull request enforces it, and no CLA is required. Please also follow CODE_OF_CONDUCT.en.md. For ordinary usage questions, see SUPPORT.en.md; report security issues privately through SECURITY.en.md.

Security

Never commit credentials or authorization files to the working tree. If you discover a security issue, follow SECURITY.en.md to report it privately rather than opening a public issue.

Privacy & telemetry

Official distribution builds include TapDB usage analytics for product-level aggregate statistics, including device identifiers, OS / app version, startup and activity events. Events are associated with your account ID after sign-in, so this is not fully anonymous. TapDB does not collect chat content, file content, or working-directory data.

You can disable usage analytics without editing code: on Desktop, use Settings → About → Usage statistics; on Mobile, use Usage statistics in Settings. The SDK checks the stored privacy-consent state and the statistics preference, which defaults to on. Accepting the Privacy Policy records consent; a one-time migration also records consent for eligible existing signed-in users.

Known Mobile exception: enterprise SSO skips the policy-acceptance step. If no analytics consent record exists and that sign-in is restored after restarting the app, the current migration can mark even a new installation as consented. With TapDB configured and statistics enabled, reporting can then start without explicit policy acceptance. See Mobile sign-in restoration and the consent migration. Turning off Usage statistics prevents reporting from being enabled by this migration.

  • Desktop stops subsequent analytics reporting immediately when disabled. Local mode (Skip sign-in) does not report to TapDB.
  • Mobile immediately unlinks the account and stops reports explicitly triggered by Cindy. An already initialized native SDK cannot be uninitialized; fully quit and relaunch the app to keep the SDK uninitialized.

Implementation: Desktop consent and settings, Desktop SDK, Mobile consent, and Mobile SDK.

Online heartbeats and diagnostic logs are separate mechanisms, unaffected by the usage statistics switch. Desktop sends heartbeats to Cindy services only during a verified cloud sign-in (account ID, platform, and version); local mode sends none. Desktop native crash dumps stay local and are never uploaded automatically. Diagnostic logs can be uploaded manually; a separate, default-off automatic crash log upload option is also available. Log uploads require privacy consent. See the heartbeat implementation and log upload rules.

Building from source? You are not required to keep analytics:

  • Desktop development builds do not initialize TapDB by default. Explicitly setting XDT_TAPDB_DEV=1 lifts the build gate but still requires consent and the statistics preference. Self-packaged Desktop builds use the same analytics gates as official builds; you can disable analytics in Settings.
  • Mobile does not initialize the SDK without injected TapDB configuration (clientId / clientToken). This does not mean all source builds default to off: the self-hosted release pipeline requires nonempty configuration, while local development permits empty values. See the Mobile build guide.

License / 许可证

Except as otherwise noted, the source code in this repository is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. Individual source files do not carry per-file license headers; the repository-root LICENSE governs.

Model weights, datasets, prompts, trademarks, and other separately identified materials may be subject to their own license terms and are not automatically covered by the repository-level Apache-2.0 grant. Third-party open-source components retain their own copyright and license. Their attribution notices and SPDX SBOMs are managed under docs/legal/, with artifact-specific outputs in docs/legal/notices/. See NOTICE for this project's copyright and attribution information.

releases.name: v0.1.125
releases.body:
Desktop release 0.1.125

## 更新说明
### 📱 手机上看清并操作设备画面
手机远程桌面现在能查看并操作插件提供的设备画面（如模拟器）：悬浮玻璃按钮汇集设备按键、方向、缩放和独立设置，可跟随手机转动或手动旋转；方向、触摸和掉线状态也已修正。 @dashhuang

### 🧩 插件能力与授权
账号头像对所有插件开放，头像下载走更安全的通道；插件能力改为按声明与用户授权统一使用，本地开发和 Forge 安装也更顺畅；插件调用会归属当前任务，卡片在对应任务里打开。 @GaoWeiLiuXD @dashhuang

### 💬 伙伴群聊更好用
伙伴群消息新增已读双勾和已读名单；折叠屏与宽屏下群聊保留左侧任务列表；群邀请链接改用分享服务，侧栏头像恢复，跳到底部和离底状态也更稳定。 @GaoWeiLiuXD @nanaco666 @zhaodengfeng @zqchris

### 💻 伙伴与远程 Agent 更稳
远程 Agent 现在使用任务所在电脑的 Cindy 技能；远程电脑掉线时会自动切到伙伴的下一个候选模型，而不是直接报错；伙伴的成果文件也与回复内容对齐了。 @dashhuang

### 🔌 模型与供应商
已有模型第二行会显示 Magpie 供应商；更名后的模型会自动迁移到现有任务，共享供应商的模型路由、插件模型来源和手动配置说明也已对齐；Claude Code 的 API Key 路由和 Codex 0.166 原生审查已修正。 @97Three @xuzini-xzn @zhousong-xd @zqchris

### ⏰ 定时任务与最近任务
伙伴的最近任务列表会显示定时任务并标注计时，按任务实际活动排序，数量上限也更准确。

### 🖼️ 预览与桌面细节
桌面预览浮在对话上方，手机预览换成玻璃质感按钮；添加目录会先列出最近使用的目录，嵌入页面的滚动不再卡住聊天窗口。侧栏浮层在窗口失活时收起，动态壁纸中断后能恢复；iOS 安全区更新闪退、灵动岛展开高度、语音输入启动、中文字体与菜单悬停也已修复。 @DavidShenXD @WZBbiao @billythegod @dashhuang @elfcv @fmfsaisai @zcinta0514

### 🔐 登录、共享任务与连接
手机登录同意文案在长语言下不再溢出；共享任务的访客不能再替主人回答授权卡，工作详情读取不再被权限误拦；多设备直连的容量分配更公平，GitHub 的 CI 汇总只统计最新一次运行，分享导入后也能正确关联 PR；中转设置在部分语言下的文案已与界面一致。 @Ruivalim @dashhuang @guanwei-xd @yan-xdt @zqchris

### 🌐 浏览器操作与 MCP 应用
浏览器自动化在把卡住的步骤交给你之前

releases.name: v0.1.124
releases.body:
Desktop release 0.1.124

## 更新说明
### 💻 多台电脑与伙伴跨电脑
Agent 现在能看到账号下所有电脑和 SSH 主机的实时资源（CPU、内存、磁盘、在跑的任务）；伙伴的技能文件会随换电脑保留，也能搜到其他电脑上的伙伴对话。 @elfcv @zqchris

### 🙋 代输入更顺手
代输入窗口最小化后会自动还原；主人可以直接在网页上登录，填好后卡片随之收起；浏览器页面读不到时，会把主人带到窗口前继续操作。 @dashhuang

### ⌨️ 手机远程键盘新布局
折叠屏手机上的远程桌面键盘重新设计，默认使用全键盘与触控板，剪贴板和快捷键集中到顶行；复古皮肤也换成新的键位布局，按键状态更准确。 @dashhuang

### 💬 手机群聊与分享更清楚
群聊的运行状态按话题分开显示，引用回复与私聊保持一致，并新增群消息通知设置；从系统分享进来的内容不再打断当前页面，侧栏也能区分群聊。 @GaoWeiLiuXD @zqchris

### 🔌 供应商、模型与用量
可以按自定义端点名称搜索供应商，模型回退后能重新选回原来的模型，共享的供应商组也能正常使用；订阅余量小组件支持置顶和隐藏账号。 @DavidShenXD @MagicLizi @WZBbiao @dashhuang @xuzini-xzn

### 📎 附件与文档阅读
桌面和手机上的附件预览统一了体验；PDF 支持宽度自适应、页码跳转和滚轮缩放；截图翻译可以选择目标语言，响应也更快，手机上的数学公式上下标显示更准确。 @DavidShenXD @dreamfarer-space @zqchris

### 🗂️ 任务与项目
可以在任务里直接新建项目并搬移文件；灵动岛已完成任务最多保留一天，Codex Micro 能显示其他电脑的任务状态；GitHub 的 PR 关联恢复，Windows 上的项目分组和审查高亮也更顺畅。 @DavidShenXD @Eapp1e @dashhuang @zqchris

### ⏰ 定时任务更干净
一次性的定时提醒触发后会自动停用，不再显示为仍在运行；例行任务撤回的提示会被及时清理，历史记录不会越积越多。 @NOOB-3301 @elfcv

### 🔐 登录与连接更可靠
登录授权会保留资源信息，「本机作为中转」登录完成即可使用；登录同意文案不再溢出，繁体中文用字已修正；请求体过大时会自动压缩重试，Claude Code 异常退出会被记录且不再重复续跑。 @Battleplus @DigitalAirMedia @NOOB-3301 @Ruivalim @guanwei-xd @remyliu33

### 🧩 插件与多 Agent 协作
停止多 Agent 协作时，如果已经切到别的任务或页面，不会再被拉回原来的协作页；协

releases.name: v0.1.122-beta
releases.body:
Desktop release 0.1.122

## 更新说明
### 🧩 插件可以带可交互页面了
插件现在可以带可交互页面，安装时单独确认权限，手机和远程设备也能打开确认，并支持文件导入导出；聊天里的表格等文件可按 7 天引用交给插件，插件还能在新建任务时选模型、为自动化做运行前检查。 @DavidShenXD @dashhuang @fmfsaisai @techsaurabh-394 @zhaodengfeng @zqchris

### 🌐 用「我的浏览器」操作自己的 Chrome
新增「我的浏览器」执行端，Agent 通过官方 Chrome 扩展操作已登录的浏览器，保留登录态；设置里可安装、启用插件和扩展，支持大文件上传、PDF 和整页截图。能力不额外设限，安全交给任务审批。 @dashhuang

### 🌍 新增五种界面语言，含文言版

## 更新说明
### 🛰️ 自建中转服务，一键部署到自己的服务器
设置里新增「中转服务」：可在这台电脑直接开启，或用 SSH 部署到自己的 Linux 服务器，自动申请并续期 HTTPS 证书，支持配对加入、升级和卸载；服务器已用 Nginx 时也能自动复用原站点。 @MagicLizi

### 🔗 分享的供应商可直接连上执行电脑
分享供应商后，对方新任务可直连组内执行电脑，获得短期授权、到期收回，断线自动改用中转；历史任务仍在原电脑续接。已分享的供应商在设置里单独成区，跨区域分享加入后自动补回列表，模型范围不重复显示同一型号。 @MagicLizi @yan-xdt @zqchris

### 🧩 本地插件也能分享安装
本地插件详情页新增分享，首次上传前先确认，相同内容再次分享直接复用；接收方登录后可在当前电脑或其他候选电脑安装固定版本，覆盖同名插件前会说明影响并让你确认。 @GaoWeiLiuXD

### 🔒 远程桌面闲置后自动断开并锁屏
远程桌面新增「无操作后断开并锁屏」，默认 5 分钟，可选 1–30 分钟或永不；控制端电脑锁屏或睡眠时立即结束远控并锁住被控电脑，回来后需手动重新连接，手机开启闲置保护后进入后台也会结束远控。 @zqchris

### 🖼️ 让模型找回聊天里的历史图片
在 Telegram、飞书、企业微信、钉钉、Discord、微信和 Slack 中，模型现在能按消息 ID 读取之前发过的图片，问「前面那张图是什么」时不用重复上传；直接引用图片时仍会自动带图。 @dashhuang

### 📱 手机端分享图片、建群和报错更顺手
手机分享含富媒体组件的消息时，图片、图表和指标会正常出图，不再打印组件协议；创建群聊的操作栏、键盘和滚动更顺；群聊运行失败改用紧凑错误卡，横向屏幕下任务侧栏的显示设置也能正常操作。 @dashhuang @zqchris

### 🤖 模型信息与远程连接更可靠
远程或分享用 Pi + ChatGPT 时不再误报模型不可用，空失败可重试，/v1 结尾的地址不再重复拼接；自己设置的工具搜索开关不被覆盖；报价标出收费项，Cindy AI 按个人或企业显示身份名称。 @Battleplus @dashhuang @fmfsaisai @saurabh-cognizn @techsaurabh-394 @zqchris

Desktop release 0.1.120

## 更新说明
### 📸 内置截图工具，直接交给 Cindy
新增内置截图工具：可截取滚动长图、录制指定区域并导出 GIF，截图和录屏能直接发给 Cindy 任务，不再依赖 IM 工具；默认快捷键可在设置中修改。 @DavidShenXD

### 🖥️ 任务免打扰与前进后退
任务右键新增「消息免打扰」：开启后不再弹通知、不上灵动岛、不推手机和飞书，未读与运行照常；左上角新增任务前进 / 后退，可用 ⌘[ / ⌘] 在最近任务间切换并支持改绑。 @WZBbiao

### 💻 换电脑继续原来的任务
把任务移到另一台电脑时，原始 Claude 会话和历史会一起带走并继续，不再从零开始；中途失败也会回落到本机，不影响原任务。 @dashhuang

### 🧩 插件能力继续扩展
插件可使用宿主模型选择器，并按电脑位置读取可用的远程模型；插件任务支持独立消息资料、自动标题和权限选择，详情页也更清爽。 @GaoWeiLiuXD @MagicLizi @PraiseZhu

### 👥 伙伴与群聊更清楚
任务列表可按伙伴筛选，并在不同电脑间保持归属；伙伴飞书连接补充了创建与首次收发指引。群聊会显示远程设备与名额限制原因，群主只能转让给真人，最近活动排序两端一致。 @Liuliuuu0710 @xuzini-xzn @zcinta0514 @zhaodengfeng

### 💳 分享供应商按成员限额
把模型供应商分享给其他成员时，可以按成员设置用量上限；超额请求会被拒绝，过期额度会自动恢复，分享管理页可直接查看用量。

### 💬 消息与输入体验更好
Telegram 回复保留引用、表格与图片说明等富文本；长回答中断只重试失败部分，不丢已生成内容；邮件排版和深色模式更易读。语音输入启动更快，手机端组字和草稿恢复不再被覆盖。 @DavidShenXD @GuoDongman @dashhuang @xuzini-xzn

### 🎨 登录页与界面细节
登录页、第三方登录按钮和浏览器回调页统一到新版视觉，浅色与深色都更完整，旧本地主题会自动迁移登录配色。侧栏筛选提示、置顶任务闪烁、设备名提示和移动端 Beta 指引也一并调整。 @DavidShenXD @dashhuang @guyong-zapo @kirozeng

### 🤖 自动化与稳定性修复
本地 Agent 可按应用创建独立任务；定时任务里无人回答的提问不再卡住整轮。自动操作页不再空白，归档任务清理后显示「历史内容已清除」，修复 Codex 规则导入、模型设置刷新丢失和供应商读取等问题。 @321sssrt-bit @BHARTIYAYASH @DavidShenXD @Eapp1e @dashhuang @sunjinshuai @xuz

aiSummary.oneLiner: An open-source, local AI agent that uses real files and logged-in applications to perform out-of-the-box tasks.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Cindy operates as a comprehensive AI agent that runs entirely locally on your own machine. It seamlessly integrates multiple harnesses, models, and tools into a single desktop experience capable of interacting with your real files and authenticated applications. Initial support includes Claude Code and Codex harnesses, with a native harness under active development. The platform allows models and harnesses to mix freely, switching mid-task depending on the workspace requirements. It connects to Cindy's official cloud services for telemetry and auto-updates while retaining local execution capabilities.
keyFeatures: Local execution: Run the AI agent directly on your machine accessing local files and authenticated apps.
Multiple harnesses: Support for Claude Code and Codex harnesses with seamless mid-task switching.
Cloud integration: Connect to official Cindy cloud services for updates while optionally running in local mode.
Skill Hub migration: Support advanced endpoints using the new cindySkillHubApiBaseUrl manifest field.
Analytics control: Allow building from source without TapDB telemetry by stripping specific initialization calls.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This agent is designed for developers and power users wanting deep local integration for automated tasks. Prerequisites include Node.js 22.x, pnpm 10.x, and Git LFS for source compilation.
